DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (PCVO).

Given the fundoscopy findings of hemorrhages and the clinical picture of headache with worsening vision in an older adult, PCVO is the leading diagnosis. I recommend requesting a complete blood count and coagulation profile to evaluate for underlying thrombotic risk factors.
